chapter: Louis Armstrong, Gene Krupa and the drum school
title: Teachers at the drum school and Metropole band

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Well at the same time you were running the drum school, you were in studio work and playing the Metropole.

Oh yeah, yeah. I used to leave the studio, I mean the drum school, five o'clock, go across there on the Copper Rail, right across from the Metropole and eat, and then go to work, and you know of course it's all according to who had students early in the morning. We had several teachers up there with us.
Well one was Sam... Goulash he died. Sticks Evans. Marty Grupp. Those were the three. A boy by the name of Bill Pede used to teach there. Those were four.
So who were you using at the Metropole?
Oh George Kelly on the saxophone, George Holt trumpet, Ivan Rolle, bass; and Jay Cole, piano.
